headline: Pranav Aggarwal vaults from 2,622nd to 24th on ARC-2

sections.text: Pranav Aggarwal added 35.69 points to reach 35.69, moving from 2,622nd to 24th on the ARC-AGI-2 board.
He now ranks 24th in a field of 2,701 teams. The gold cutoff is 40.83, with 15 places available.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
